name: Astral Projection

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: for each target, a jacinth worth 1,000+ GP and a silver bar worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: you and up to eight willing creatures within range

summary: You and up to eight willing creatures travel the Astral Plane in astral forms while your bodies lie in suspended animation.
text: Each astral form has its owner's statistics and gear and is tied to its body by a silver cord; cutting the cord kills, and a body or form at 0 Hit Points ends the spell for that creature. Entering a portal to another plane brings the body along, and a Magic action dismisses the spell for everyone.
